## Governance, and the whales 🐋

- JuMP and SciML wrote their governance down after they were already
  large, and Turing has contributing guidance instead
- None of them says how an org starts, or how a package joins one
- 🐋 Every project I have worked on has ended up with one person doing most
  of it
- 🐳 Julia's composability does not fix that. The median Julia package has
  two contributors, and this ecosystem has its own whales
- Here the whale is me and a subscription
- 🌍 Who can do this work at all is narrowing. Agents make that worse,
  because the subscription is the barrier and access is not equal
- I started `epinowcast` in 2021 to avoid what happened with `EpiNow2`.
  It did not work
- The people I build for work in R in the middle of an outbreak response.
  Multiple dispatch is not a feature to them, it is why the install is
  unfamiliar
